body.x: ‘Anyractive’ has been chosen in advance of the 'BEST OF MIK CES TOP10', scheduled to participate in 'CES 2018 (Consumer Technology Show)', the world's largest IT exhibition, that will take place in Las Vegas, the USA from 9th to 12th of January.GoTouch, IoT the electric board, is designed to be portable and setup takes minutes. It consists of an infrared sensor, pen, and application. Without additional purchases, it can instantly turn any TV, monitor, or projector into an interactive whiteboard where users can write or draw on. Anyone can use this product at an affordable cost. It also has a function of collaboration that is able to share the same interactive screen in real time.Anyractive that recently launched their first successful entry into USA’ market by ‘BestBuy’, the largest electronics retailer in the USA, earned $110,396 in revenue from Kickstarter and $74,558 from Indigogo in September 2016. An official said: “Based on our experience of Kickstarter and Indigogo, we are preparing to launch ‘Makuake’ that is a Japanese crowdfunding platform. In the future, we are going to make a plan in order to expand its market to not only the USA and Japan but the global market.”Anyractive’s GoTouch is recognised around the world for its possibilities through crowdfunding and nominated as the winner of Winovation(application contest) by Samsung as well. It is also certified as an innovative product by the education office and public institutions, recognised as a potential one both home and abroad by receiving awards from the Education Minister and the Minister of Science, ICT and Future Planning.Meanwhile, “BEST OF MADE IN KOREA CES TOP10” selected only 10 companies among CES 2018 exhibitors by Aving News and foreign reporters such as the US and China considering the trend of the company, growth rate, and prospects. During the exhibition period, each media will select the TOP 3 through final screening and announce it officially on the last day of the exhibition.CES, the world's largest IT exhibition, is an exhibition of trends in the global consumer electronics industry, held annually in January by the American Consumer Technology Association (CTA). Aving News reported the most issues of CES, MWC, and IFA, which are world's top three tech exhibitions, during last 11 years. It is sending special reporters to CES for this year as well; reporting major issues in the world market and introduce Korea's major companies all over the world.
